rationale: The stock is trading at the absolute high of its range (100% position) immediately following a 25% gap-up, creating an unfavorable risk-reward profile for a long entry due to the proximity of the stop-loss to the entry price. While the short side offers a wider stop distance, entering a short against a strong momentum breakout with 13.7x relative volume and a rising market (SPY +1.82%) carries significant risk of a squeeze. The combination of extreme extension and high volatility suggests waiting for a pullback or consolidation rather than initiating a new position at the highs.
